content.productDescription:
Bring a real sense of peace and meaning into your home with this Islamic calligraphy wall art print — genuinely one of my favourite choices when it comes to artwork for a living room that feels both modern and deeply personal. The Arabic script spells out Ayat An-Nur, the Verse of Light from the Quran, with the English translation 'Allah Is The Light of the Heavens and the Earth' printed in elegant spaced lettering beneath it. It's the kind of piece that draws you in every time you walk past it.

What I love most about this print is how the calligraphy sits within a flowing, fluid abstract background of soft dusty blue, warm blush-rose, and creamy white — all swirling together like marble or smoke. The Arabic script itself is rendered in a deep rose-gold tone, with warm brown-rose outlines that give it real depth and presence against that dreamy background. It's contemporary and calm, never fussy, and it works beautifully as a standalone statement piece.

What's Included with Artwork for a Living Room Allah Is The Light Islamic Calligraphy Wall Art Print

  • A single high-quality art print featuring Ayat An-Nur Arabic calligraphy with a fluid abstract background in dusty blue, blush-rose, and white tones
  • Printed in the UK using fade-resistant pigment inks for long-lasting colour and clarity
  • Suitable for indoor display only
  • Framed and canvas-wrapped options arrive fully ready to hang — no hunting for a frame that fits, which saves a lot of time and effort
  • Choose between unframed and framed options in multiple sizes and in Luster or Museum quality; also available in wrapped canvas size options

How to Style Artwork for a Living Room with Islamic Calligraphy

I'd hang this print as a centrepiece above a sofa or console table, where it can really breathe and be appreciated. Because the background uses soft, neutral-leaning tones — those dusty blues and blush pinks — it pairs really well with both cool and warm wall colours. Think pale grey, warm white, soft sage, or even a deeper slate blue wall; all of them let the calligraphy step forward without any clash. If your living room already has some rose, blush, or navy accents in cushions or a rug, this print will feel like it was always meant to be there.

It's also a wonderful choice for Eid or Ramadan — a meaningful gift or a seasonal refresh that feels special without being temporary. For an everyday display, I think this works best on its own rather than in a gallery wall, simply because the calligraphy deserves the spotlight. If you do want to pair it with other pieces, keep the surrounding prints minimal and abstract so the Arabic script remains the focal point. Have a look at our Islamic wall art collection for prints that complement this beautifully.

Choosing the Right Size and Finish for This Print

When it comes to picking the right size, think about the wall space you have around it. This is a portrait-format print with a lot of visual energy in the centre, so it tends to work best when there's a bit of breathing room on either side — a larger size will really let the flowing background and the script shine. If the wall is fairly compact, a medium size works just as well and keeps everything feeling intentional rather than crowded.

For the finish, I'd personally lean towards Museum quality paper if you want the richest depth of colour — those dusty blue swirls and the rose-gold tones in the calligraphy really pop on it. Luster paper is a brilliant choice too, giving a subtle sheen that keeps the colours vivid and the print looking crisp. If you prefer a more textural, gallery feel without glass, the wrapped canvas option is a great pick. Scroll down to see how each size looks in a living room before you decide — there's a handy size-guide image below showing every option in a real room setting.

aiItems.content:
What is artwork for a living room?

Artwork for a living room is any wall art print or decorative piece chosen to add personality, colour, and meaning to your main shared living space. The best choices reflect your personal style — whether that's abstract, illustrative, photographic, or calligraphic — while complementing your existing colours and furniture. Islamic calligraphy prints are a particularly popular option, combining spiritual meaning with a striking visual presence that works in both traditional and contemporary living rooms. A single well-chosen print can anchor a wall and bring the whole room together without needing a large collection.

How to Choose and Hang Artwork for a Living Room

1. Pick your focal wall: Identify the wall you naturally look at most — above the sofa, behind a console table, or facing the doorway. This is where your main art print will have the most impact.

2. Match colours to your room: Look at your existing cushions, rugs, and wall colour and choose a print that picks up at least one of those tones. For this Islamic calligraphy print, dusty blue, blush-rose, or warm neutral rooms are a natural fit.

3. Choose the right size: Measure your wall space before ordering. As a rule, your print should fill roughly two-thirds of the width of any furniture it sits above. Use the size-guide image on this page to visualise each option in a living room.

4. Decide on framed, unframed, or canvas: Framed and canvas-wrapped prints arrive ready to hang straight away. Unframed prints give you the flexibility to choose your own frame to match your existing décor.

5. Hang at eye level: The centre of the print should sit at roughly 145–150 cm from the floor — this is the standard gallery hanging height and it feels the most natural when you're standing in the room.

Comparing Your Print Options for This Islamic Calligraphy Wall Art

Option — Unframed Print: Printed on your choice of Luster art paper or Museum quality paper. You provide your own frame. Best if you want to match a specific frame style or colour in your home.

Option — Framed Print: Your chosen print on Luster or Museum quality paper, supplied in a frame and ready to hang straight away. Saves time and removes the hassle of sourcing a correctly sized frame.

Option — Wrapped Canvas: The artwork is printed directly onto canvas and stretched over a wooden frame — no glass, no print paper. Arrives ready to hang and gives a more textural, gallery-style finish. Available in canvas-specific size options.

Paper quality — Luster Art Paper: A semi-sheen finish that keeps colours vivid and crisp. A great all-round choice for this print's flowing blues and rose-gold tones.

Paper quality — Museum Quality Paper: A premium fine-art paper with richer colour depth and a more pronounced finish. Ideal if you want the calligraphy and background tones to have maximum visual impact.
